subject: RE: 2026/4274 — thank you; D153 at NLW; source of DRA/11/120 note
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Louise / Glamorgan Archives,

Thank you for your reply of 6 October 2026 under reference 2026/4274.

I note and accept:

1. D153/1–8 is held at the National Library of Wales. I will pursue that sequence with NLW (catalogue entry for deeds in p. Llandough including the dwelling adjoining the churchyard, 1811, D153/1–2).

2. DRA/11/120 (formerly D/DRa 11/120) forms part of the Elder’s Navigation Colliery, Maesteg series (DRA/11/1–293) and does not relate to Llandough-juxta-Penarth or to Tynywain. I will not treat it as evidence for this site.

The DRA/11/120 form appeared in secondary notes I was checking; your correction is helpful and I will mark it as a wrong reference for this research.

No further action is requested from Glamorgan Archives on those two points. I remain grateful for the earlier 2026/4097 searches and copy offers.

Yours faithfully,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
Royal Signals Cyber/Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member
